types.rule: the exact disjoint equal-length local-rewrite swap rule v0

quantifier: both declared squares, all eight factor occurrences, eleven declared cases, and exact two-order replay under one rule
arithmetic_domain: finite S4 reduced words, exact ordered paths, equal-length local rewrites, half-open intervals, finite index maps, and SHA-256 pins
evaluation: verify the pinned typed-comparison-segment implementation and target digest
reconstruct and validate all four segments
bind exactly one declared rule id and the reversed factor correspondence
replay both factor orders from one source word to one target word
verify disjoint intervals and preservation of the other redex after the first rewrite
reuse the construction on a fresh disjoint square
